related.reason_vi: Elasticsearch bên trong: bộ phân tích, chỉ mục ngược, segment, shard.

claims.evidence: Statements were checked against elastic/docs-content at commit 55f05da44f1e68caf6b83d60715f6a41bcdaa2d3 and the reference docs of elastic/elasticsearch at tag v9.5.5 (commit 48acba663b09e70b115dd879329141506c377890), read from partial clones, and against an experiment run on 2026-10-18 with the official elasticsearch:9.5.5 Docker image (single node, basic license, security disabled), whose build hash is that commit.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright 1.56, headless) rendered lesson.md converted by markdown-it (CommonMark, tables, raw HTML) with a 16 px page gutter and every <details> open, at 320, 375 and 430 px: document scrollWidth equalled the viewport at each width. Smallest figure text from the SVG font sizes times the shown scale: 13.5 px at 320, 15.0 px at 375. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser measured every figure line. Not GitHub's renderer, not a real phone, not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: Documents become searchable in near real time after a refresh; by default indices refresh every second, but only those that received a search in the last 30 seconds.
claims.verified_by: Read; the experiment counted 0 documents right after indexing and 5 after POST _refresh.

claims.claim_vi: text fields are analyzed into terms for full-text search and are not used for sorting and seldom for aggregations; fielddata is off by default; keyword suits structured content; a field can be both via multi-fields.
claims.section: text type; Use a field as both text and keyword; fielddata
claims.verified_by: Read; the experiment's terms aggregation on a text field failed with 'Fielddata is disabled on [name]' and on the keyword field returned ao 3, giay 2.

claims.claim_vi: Doc values are an on-disk columnar structure for sorting and aggregations, supported on most field types except text.
The asciifolding filter drops diacritical marks; the standard analyzer keeps them.
claims.verified_by: Read; the experiment analyzed 'Áo Khoác Gió' as áo, khoác, gió with standard and as ao, khoac, gio with lowercase plus asciifolding; a match query for 'ao khoac' returned 0 hits on the standard-analyzed field.

claims.claim_vi: Elasticsearch supports geo_point and geo_shape fields and geo queries that combine with full-text queries.
claims.verified_by: Read; a 5 km geo_distance query in the experiment returned the three products of the two stores near the centre point.

claims.claim_vi: A data stream is a named abstraction over backing indices for append-only time series such as logs, events and metrics; an alias with a write index fits better when documents with the same _id are rewritten.
claims.verified_by: Read; the experiment's first write to logs-checkout-default created backing index .ds-logs-checkout-default-2026.10.18-000001, and a PUT with an id was refused: only write ops with an op_type of create are allowed in data streams.

claims.claim_vi: Machine learning setup needs an appropriate subscription level or the free trial; the experiment tested only an anomaly detection job.
claims.verified_by: Read; creating an anomaly detection job on the basic license returned 'current license is non-compliant for [ml]'.

claims.claim_vi: Elastic Security unifies SIEM, XDR, endpoint and cloud security and uses Elasticsearch for search and analytics and Kibana for visualization.
The number of primary shards is fixed when an index is created; the field type of an existing field cannot be changed, a new index and a reindex are needed.
claims.section: Clusters, nodes, and shards; Update the mapping of a field

design_notes_vi: Sáu thẻ cách dùng chia hai phần, mỗi thẻ ghi tính năng gánh việc đó; bốn ghi chú kết quả thử. Vẽ bằng scripts/figures.
source_deviations: Source lists six uses with their benefits; the lesson names the feature behind each (analyzer and inverted index, aggregations on keyword fields and refresh, geo_point, data streams) and tests it.
Source places machine learning in X-Pack; the current docs require an appropriate subscription or trial, and the experiment shows the basic license refusing an anomaly detection job.
Source calls analytics real time; the lesson uses near real time, as the Elastic docs do, and shows a document not visible before a refresh.
Lesson adds a point specific to Vietnamese: the standard analyzer keeps diacritics, so a query without them misses unless an ASCII folding filter is configured.
